purpose: 過去の生成指示。現在の採用画像・実装状態・人の承認を示すものではない。

entries.name: アルダ
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. EDIT THE SUPPLIED CURRENT v1 アルダ (alda) portrait, preserving this exact character. Make THREE VERY VISIBLE CORRECTIONS:
1) ROUND FACE: smooth round cheeks leading into a broad rounded U-shaped jaw and rounded chin. Absolutely NO pointed V chin, triangular face or angular polygon jaw corners. Keep original age, gender, expression, face/head size.
2) COMPLETE EYE OUTLINES: each white eye enclosed by one unbroken continuous dark contour: upper eyelid AND lower eyelid JOIN at both INNER and OUTER corners. No missing line near tear ducts, no open lower contour, no floating iris. Iris meets/overlaps upper eyelid, preserve eye shape/color/pupil and eyelashes. No catchlights.
3) STRONG READABLE MANGA SCREENTONE: replace faint near-invisible tiny stippling with crisp coarse regular ROUND BLACK HALFTONE DOTS in existing shadow shapes on hair undersides, neck, clothing folds. Dot diameter 4–6 pixels at 1086 width, pitch 7–10px. Dots must remain visibly separate and clearly readable when portrait is shrunk to300px wide. Strong black dots over existing colorful flat shadow planes. Not dust/grain, not pale tiny dots, not crosshatch, not gray haze, not large black filled masses. Lit areas stay bright clean flat colors. Do not darken entire image.
Preserve existing feminine eyelashes on BOTH outer corners and red ribbon on image-right ponytail; tanned skin, blond-brown two tone hair, rose-red irises. Face should become softly ROUND, wide rounded chin, never pointed.
LOCK all other features: exact hairstyle, species, accessories, clothing design and palette, pose, hands, anatomical proportions, shoulder width, head scale and expression, same portrait composition. Clean outlines and flat cel color areas. Portrait3:4. Keep head high with small transparent margin, both hands/sleeves inside left/right edges, body/clothing continues through bottom edge. Preserve actual transparent background. No text, panels, labels, watermark or background. This task ONLY corrects face contour, eye contour completeness and visible halftone.

entries.name: ハスキー
entries.prompt:
Precisely edit this current HUSKY white-haired canine-eared maid portrait. TWO edits are mandatory and must be visibly stronger than this reference:
(A) Replace the SHARP CORNER at the bottom-right of the jaw/chin with a VERY ROUND U-shape. Make lower face broad and softly curved like an oval, not triangular, no straight edge meeting at a pointed vertex anywhere along jaw. This is the main defect in supplied image. Round cheeks but keep existing adult identity, blue eyes, small fang and mischievous smile. Eye whites retain complete connected upper/lower black outlines at both corners.
(B) Replace all faint tiny screentone with much COARSER clearly BLACK regular round dots. On white apron and white sleeves the shadow shapes MUST be obvious manga dotted regions, with black dot diameter6px and pitch10px at1086width. On hair, ear shadows, neck, sleeves, bow undersides use same coarse obvious dot pattern. Especially WHITE sleeve and apron must not look almost blank at300px thumbnail width. Don't spread tone on all white cloth; only existing shadow planes with clear rounded boundary. Do not use fine pale dust/grain, faint gray dots, gradients or crosshatch.
Everything else LOCKED: this exact pose, hands, black bows and gloves, cream-white maid outfit, gold buckles, ears and tail, head and body proportions, palette and cropping. No redesign. Actual transparent background; no backdrop. Keep both eyes completely continuously outlined, no highlights.
